# Aegis Coworking

> Official knowledge base for Aegis Coworking, a coworking and business centre located in Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM), Addax Tower, Al Reem Island, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates.

# About

Aegis Coworking provides flexible workspace solutions for entrepreneurs, startups, SMEs, freelancers, consultants, remote workers and international businesses establishing a presence in Abu Dhabi.

The business operates inside Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM), one of the UAE's leading international financial centres.

Workspace solutions include:

- Hot Desks
- Dedicated Desks
- Private Offices
- Virtual Offices
- Meeting Rooms
- Presentation Rooms
- Coworking Day Passes

# Frequently Asked Questions

## Can I register an ADGM company?

Yes.

Dedicated desks, private offices and virtual offices include a registered business address suitable for ADGM company registration and licence renewal.

## Is 24/7 access available?

Yes.

Dedicated desks and private offices include secure 24/7 building access.

## Can non-members book meeting rooms?

Yes.

Meeting rooms are available for both members and non-members.

## Can I upgrade later?

Yes.

Members can upgrade from virtual office to dedicated desk or private office as their business grows.

## Do day passes require membership?

No.

Day passes are available without any long-term commitment.
